public_identity.claim_boundary: Show the configured public identity and address. Do not claim current Basename resolution, platform verification, score movement or ownership changes without release-time official readback.

current_release_evidence.historical_receipt_guard: A receipt created for an earlier release_id, fingerprint or BOM is historical context only and cannot prove the current publication unit.
current_release_evidence.platform_independence: Each of the eight required platforms is an independent evidence gate. Missing, stale, inferred or cross-copied evidence makes the publication unit count zero.
current_release_evidence.candidate_boundary: A locally complete release candidate remains non-public and non-counting until independent Sol/medium acceptance and the exact owner-visible external gate.

attribution_rules.builder_code: Use a project Builder Code where the current Base implementation supports it; verify attribution in base.dev before claiming it.
attribution_rules.base_app_profile: Use the wallet-address profile deeplink or current supported Base App surface; do not rely on deprecated mini-app methods.
attribution_rules.basename: Display gaysonloser.base.eth with the full wallet address. Setting or changing a primary Basename is a separate owner-approved transaction.
attribution_rules.cross_platform_consistency: Every platform row for one publication unit must share the same material outcome and release fingerprint.

forbidden_claims: simulated transaction presented as a real receipt
testnet receipt presented as a Base Mainnet transaction
partial platform bundle presented as a completed publication unit
Basename ownership or resolution inferred only from workspace configuration
Arc/Circle result presented as a Base result without Base-native implementation evidence
historical platform receipt presented as evidence for the current release
chain success presented as ERP posting, business close or eight-platform completion
